key_concepts: Dry season in the Philippines occurs from January to April
Wet season in the Philippines is from May to October
July and August have the highest rainfall and most rainy days
February and March have the least rainfall
May, June, September, and October have high rainfall next to July and August
Southwest monsoon or Hanging Habagat brings wet-season rains
Northeast monsoon or Hanging Amihan brings cool dry winds
Dry season has less precipitation and warm days
Rice planting is favorable in June and July when precipitation is high
February has the least rainfall and the lowest temperature
